map.输入中子通量 Φ、微观截面 σ、靶核数 N，求反应率。: Enter neutron flux Phi, microscopic cross-section sigma and target number N to compute the reaction rate.
map.R = 通量 Φ × 截面 σ × 靶核数 N 得反应率。: R = flux Phi x cross-section sigma x target number N gives the reaction rate.
map.反应堆、活化分析测算。: Reactor physics and activation analysis estimates.

map.：R = 1e13 × 1e-28 × 1e20 = 1×10⁵ s⁻¹；通量翻: R = 1e13 * 1e-28 * 1e20 = 1e5 s-1; a tenfold increase in flux gives a tenfold increase in rate.
map.：若 σ=1e-24（barn 级），则 R=1e9 s⁻¹，反应显著增强。: If sigma = 1e-24 (barn level), then R = 1e9 s-1, a markedly stronger reaction.
